snippet.title: Scopa Sweep Trailer
snippet.description: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike with a local restaurant theme playing cards at the table. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses. Aim of the game is to maximise the score gained and beat the table!
